text_block_list.text: Today is interview day for the most promising Umamusume. It begins with a photoshoot in their Racewear, followed by individual interviews, but—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—My running, my victories, are all dedicated
to the "King" who walks this path with me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"To display a knight's glory and fulfill
my loyalty to my liege. This racing outfit—
is the embodiment of that resolve."
...Given all the preparation put into today, her responses are remarkably impressive. There's no need to worry—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well then, would it be alright
if I asked your Trainer a few questions as well?
choice_data_list: (...Huh!? Why me all of a sudden!?)
(...Huh!? Why me all of a sudden!?)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, could you sum up
Durandal's greatest strength in a single phrase?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My liege...
Please, answer as your heart desires...!

"Right, calm down—
Her strength is 'running with sharper acceleration than anyone else.'
If I concisely explain that leg power to her—let's see—"
choice_data_list: Ah, m-my leg— it's cramped up!

text_block_list.name: Stirred Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?"
"What did you just say...?"
"'Legs'? ...'Flavor'...?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...Th-Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Good work, my liege.
choice_data_list: ...You totally stumbled over your words, huh?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
All will be well! They are professionals as well.
I am certain they will grasp my Lord's intentions!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Headline
text_block_list.text:
"Promising Umamusume's Trainer
Suddenly Speaks for the Wrath of Seafood!
What is the 'Infuriated Horse Mackerel'...!?'"

text_block_list.name: Student Who Read the Article A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's the horse mackerel person.
You know, the one in charge of Durandal-san—

text_block_list.name: Student Who Read the Article B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Durandal-san is forbidden from having fried horse mackerel?
If she ate it right in front of her, that person would totally snap, and—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "P-Please take heart, my liege...!"
choice_data_list: I flubbed my line and ended up embarrassing you too...
Because I flubbed my lines, I brought shame to you as well...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...! Even now, you care more
for me than yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...My Liege. You were scheduled to
run in a mock race this week, correct?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As a knight, I swear.
I shall take the dishonor you suffered
and turn it into a thunderous storm of glory.

And on the day of the mock race.
Perhaps to scout promising Umamusume,
several reporters could be seen in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Forgive my delay, my Liege.
I was taking a brief moment to focus my mind.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Today, I run prepared... to stake my knightly pride.
That is precisely why... it had to be this outfit.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"—To all the members of the press gathered here today,
hear this! Today, I—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Like an enraged horse mackerel cleaving through the sea!
I swear to show you an overwhelming run!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And—you shall soon come
to realize the true meaning
behind my Lord's words!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!
And—Durandal showcased terrifying acceleration, as if cleaving through water itself!

text_block_list.name: Surprised Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! What was that run?!
It was almost like... yes—

text_block_list.name: Commentating Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Like a fish charging furiously through the depths—
No! Is that running style like a rampaging
Leviathan!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
W-What an overwhelming victory...!
Is that... the true power of a "sharp horse mackerel"?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes—a "sharpness" that feels like it could cleave the sea in two.
An "intensity" akin to rage.
And—the horse mackerel known for its exquisite "taste."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"A trinity of a knight, possessing strength, spirit, and splendor.
That is the very title bestowed upon me by the 'King.'
—The true meaning of 'Furious Aji.'"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: S-So that's what was going on...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—To serve such a magnificent lord,
I truly consider myself most fortunate.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Allow me to use this occasion to pledge my loyalty to the 'King'—once more, right here."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a beautiful bond of trust...!
Trainer-san, please share a few words with us!
choice_data_list: I'll focus my guidance on sharpening her burst of speed.

text_block_list.text:
Since the timing was right,
I tried re-saying the line I flubbed back then.
However—

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: I see... So this coaching is meant to develop that "razor-sharp edge" momentum...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: S-Sharpness... It's all about sharpness...!

The course correction was a failure, but—regardless,
it was an episode where I deeply felt Durandal's way of life as a knight.

text_block_list.name: Stirred Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"Huh..."
"What's with that pose..."
"Is she trying to intimidate us...?"
choice_data_list: ...N-No, it was just a light joke, or...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, my liege is being subjected to humiliation again...!
Kh, I must strike the same pose as well――
I ended up doing something unnecessary in the end, but... I was glad to feel the earnest sincerity Durandal showed toward me.
